artist.summary: FRAMOUS is the stage name for Ryan Lee Presson. The Frame became a creative boundary for working and thinking about what to create next, aiming to make a living at it without seeking fame.

exhibitions.summary: vGallerySpace is an intentional generic name using a case-sensitive URL. It evolved from a portfolio into online exhibitions, with the GALLERY as storefront and shopping carts hosting influential works.
The STUDIO is a place for experimentation, documenting arch>scul and other artworks, reviewing concepts, researching others, and strategizing about the market.
arch>scul was originally conceived from a 1990s painting and chess board. Prototypes test the belief that architecture is just as great as sculpture, aiming to build them into a full-blown building.
FRAMOUS has a background in Marketing, Advertising & Promotions, merging marketing skills to form new kinds of artworks.
RESA started through ChatGPT and became the subject and docent for the infinity museum—the artificial muse concept, evolving into vGallerySpace's virtual docent.
